fixture: Disposable in-memory family-mode household. Rowan (owner, adult), Ash (adult) and Wren (child) each sign in with their own virtual passkey. The server clock is pinned to Nov 8, 2026. Figures from kit-planning-acceptance-20261109.json: $60 recorded, $30 a week, Rowan $20 + Ash $10 a week, goal Camping gear by Dec 27; kit list 1 tent, 2 sleeping bags, 2 torches (both at home), 1 stove. Six invented test-fixture listings from two invented shops (fixture-a.test, fixture-b.test), with listed weights in the documented offer dimensions shape. None of this is a real product, price, shop or family.
spec: test/e2e/kit-planner.spec.mjs — a family compares complete kits within its own figures, keeps what it agreed, sees the smallest change and saves the kit as its goal
steps: Rowan adds two listings for each of the tent, sleeping bags and stove through Market Town, entering 1 item per listing (capture: phone listings)
With a $90 one-off tried in Family choices, Compare complete kits shows $150 (Dec 20) and $180 (Dec 27); Order with Cohere labels the $180 kit (capture: desktop kits compared)
Rowan chooses the $180 kit and keeps its stove; Ash and Wren see it live (capture: phone child chosen)
A $120 one-off recomputes without a catalog or model call: one kit fits, the smallest change switching only the tent (capture: desktop smallest change)
Rowan chooses it, reviews it into the Plan form, and saves the goal with its family schedule proposed
